label: Late copy-phase steps (t>=10) with certain input letters (j,u,s,v,w,...)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), at recall_idx >= 1, and essentially only at absolute step t >= 10, so it is dominated by long sequences (L=9 holds 70% of mass, L>=8 91%). Within that window rate peaks at t=10-11 (recall_idx 2) and at the final steps t=16-17 of L=9 sequences, dipping at t=13-14. Input-token identity modulates it strongly: j, u, s, v, w (rate 10-18% vs ~5% base) and to a lesser extent f, e, b, m, i. (phase==2)&(t>=10) alone covers 97% of mass but with precision 0.18; adding the token set raises precision to ~0.36 at mass recall 0.70. Even in the best conditions it fires on under 40% of steps, so the description is incomplete; largest activations are on j/s/e inputs at the last copy steps of L=9 sequences.
